title.zh: 将南达沃省迪戈斯市陆路运输办公室分区办事处由D类升级为C类并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Upgrading the District Office of the Land Transportation Office in the City of Digos, Province of Davao Del Sur, From Class ‘D’ to Class ‘C’ and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Upgrading the District Office of the Land Transportation Office in the City of Digos, Province of Davao Del Sur, From Class ‘D’ to Class ‘C’ and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật nâng cấp Văn phòng Khu vực Cơ quan Vận tải Đường bộ tại Thành phố Digos, Tỉnh Davao Del Sur từ loại ‘D’ lên loại ‘C’
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติปรับสถานะสำนักงานเขตสำนักการขนส่งทางบกในนครดีโกส จังหวัดดาเวาเดลซูร์ จากชั้น ‘ดี’ เป็นชั้น ‘ซี’
title.id: Undang-Undang Menaikkan Kelas Kantor Distrik Kantor Transportasi Darat di Kota Digos, Provinsi Davao Del Sur dari Kelas ‘D’ menjadi Kelas ‘C’
title.ms: Akta Meningkatkan Tahap Pejabat Daerah Jabatan Pengangkutan Jalan Raya di Bandar Digos, Wilayah Davao Del Sur daripada Kelas ‘D’ kepada Kelas ‘C’

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2025/ra_12129_2025.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The district office of the Land Transportation Office (LTO) in the City of Digos, Province of Davao del Sur is hereby upgraded from Class "D" to a Class "C" district office.

The Secretary of the Department of Transportation shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of the LTO District Office in the City of Digos, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year's appropriation of LTO Region XI. Thereafter, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect after fifteen (15) days following the completion of its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
